title: The Law Association of Zambia and Others v The Attorney General [2025] ZMCC 21 (25 November 2025)
case_name: The Law Association of Zambia and Others v The Attorney General
issue_tags: Technical Committee on Constitutional Amendments (Presidential appointment 2 October 2025)
tripartite test for conservatory orders (prima facie case, irreparable damage, balance of convenience)
Munir Zulu and Anor v Attorney General [2025] ZMCC 12
outcome_detail: Notice of motion for a conservatory order to restrain the Technical Committee on Amendments to the Constitution (appointed by the President of Zambia on 2 October 2025) from continuing its work pending determination of the substantive petition dismissed (paragraphs [92]–[93]). Single-judge Mapani-Kawimbe JC held the petitioners failed to establish a prima facie case, did not demonstrate irreparable damage if the order was refused, and the balance of convenience lay with the public interest in allowing the Technical Committee to continue. Parties bear their own costs (paragraph [94]).
